title: OpenClapper · Platform
description: Workers, D1, R2 and Durable Objects: the account-wide totals Cloudflare bills on, then each environment on its own resources for debugging. Ranges over 32 days fail on the per-resource panels (Cloudflare's limit per query). Generated by grafana/build.mjs in the deploy repository.

infinityQuery.root_selector: if (.success == false) then error([.errors[]?.message] | join("; ")) else [.result[] | select(.name == "openclapper-db") | { uuid }] end
if (.success == false) then error([.errors[]?.message] | join("; ")) else [.result[] | select(.name == "openclapper-staging-db") | { uuid }] end

panels.title: Workers: requests per day, every script
panels.description: All Workers of the account, as Cloudflare counts them toward the plan.

targets.root_selector: if ((.errors // []) | length) > 0 then error([.errors[].message] | join("; ")) else ([.data.viewer.accounts[]?.workersInvocationsAdaptive[]? | { time: (.dimensions.date + "T00:00:00Z"), script: (.dimensions.scriptName), requests: (.sum.requests) }] | group_by([.time, .script]) | map({ time: (.[0].time), script: (.[0].script), requests: (map(.requests) | add) }) | sort_by(.time)) end

R2: storage per bucket (stacked = the account total)
panels.description: Payload plus metadata, the largest sample per bucket and bucket of time. Storage is billed on the account total, every bucket together. Cloudflare samples it, so it lags uploads and deletes.
